summary: WISeKey International Holding AG filed a routine Form 6-K for September 2026, a foreign-private-issuer current report mapping to a US Form 8-K. The filing is largely a forward-looking-statements and risk-factor disclosure covering fiscal 2026 revenue growth guidance of 50% to 100%, a commercial pipeline exceeding $225 million through 2029, product certifications, and strategic investments. It references previously announced proposals for WISeSat.Space Holdings to combine with Columbus Acquisition Corp. and Quantisimo with GigCapital8 Corp., but announces no new special-situation transaction, terms, board recommendation, or advisor. No deal economics are stated.
